title: McMinnville photo string revealed at French conference

tellings.quote: this uh conference in in France a couple

related.note: Both are about the 1950 McMinnville Trent photos. This telling says a string was revealed at a French conference, which makes them a hoax, while the story calls them unfalsifiable.

plain: The McMinnville photos, two famous 1950 pictures of a saucer-shaped object over a farm in McMinnville, Oregon, are said to have been shown at a conference in France to have a string in them, suggesting the object was hanging from something. A researcher named Clas Svahn mentions this only in passing, saying it came out at "this conference in France a couple" of years back, without naming who presented it. If it holds, one of the best-known UFO photographs would show a small model hung from a line.
